queries: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.WBC) AS average_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.patient_id, pa.sex, pa.average_wbc, pa.ratio, pa.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pa.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / NULLIF(l.HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT pp.ID AS patient_id, pp.SEX AS sex, pp.avg_wbc, pp.ratio, pp.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference FROM per_patient AS pp CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE pp.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
